scope: Commercial/admin views, authentication and standalone access/error pages. Shared component CSS and the complete browser matrix are maintained by the parent agent.
review_method: Source inventory of all owned Blade views, including forms, lists, detail screens, conditional sections and modals
Inline style and stylesheet cascade scan
Consolidation of duplicated module appearance without changes to business JS/controllers/models
Directed workflow tests and Blade compilation; browser matrix is reported separately

findings.problem: Repeated appended selectors provided competing desktop and mobile grids, control sizes and action colors.
findings.correction: Consolidated the stylesheet, retained one grid definition with responsive overrides, and delegated ordinary component appearance to shared ERP CSS.
findings.status: implemented; browser evidence consolidated in shared matrix

findings.problem: Inputs, selectors and charge fields used different 32px, 33px and 35px heights.
findings.correction: Removed local field skins; shared 38px controls, typography, borders and radius apply to fields and enhanced widgets.
findings.status: implemented; browser evidence consolidated in shared matrix

findings.problem: Custom toolbar variants and an independently styled item table diverged from other ERP actions and listings.
findings.correction: Added canonical btn-primary, btn-success, btn-danger-outline and btn-secondary modifiers while preserving all behavior hooks; table now uses table-scroll and cms-table.
findings.status: implemented; browser evidence consolidated in shared matrix

findings.problem: Long linked product names and a narrow detail-action column could overflow or clip controls.
findings.correction: Enabled safe wrapping for product names, fixed the action column at 104px, and contained narrow-screen table scrolling in the table wrapper.
findings.status: implemented; browser evidence consolidated in shared matrix

findings.problem: Controls were 47px/49px with separate corner radii, borders, button gradient and font sizing.
findings.correction: Loaded shared tokens in the three standalone views; controls and primary actions now consume shared dimensions and appearance while retaining brand shell and logo.
findings.status: implemented; browser evidence consolidated in shared matrix

findings.problem: License-blocked page embedded a separate style implementation and both error pages differed from common component geometry.
findings.correction: Reused user-message-page.css in both views and shared tokens for card, typography, controls and primary buttons.
findings.status: implemented; browser evidence consolidated in shared matrix

findings.problem: Operational layout rules were embedded in an inline style block/attribute.
findings.correction: Moved only structural visibility and action-row layout to commercial-workspace.css; field, button and card appearance remains centralized.
findings.status: implemented; browser evidence consolidated in shared matrix

findings.problem: New-sale action differed from the existing green primary creation action used in module toolbars.
findings.correction: Applied the canonical btn-success and grid-primary-action modifiers.
findings.status: implemented; browser evidence consolidated in shared matrix

tests.check: BladeCompiler compileString and php -l of all modified Blade views

deliberate_variants.reason: Logo, background, 490px maximum shell width and panel spacing preserve the existing brand layout; controls consume the shared tokens.
Flat inner sections avoid nested card frames. Field grids, imported XML mappings and conditional product selectors remain functional structures.
680px table minimum at narrow viewports is confined to table-scroll; data columns and actions remain usable without page-wide horizontal scroll.
Quotation PDF and receipt print geometry remain unchanged.

business_changes: None: action IDs, event hooks, routes, validation, permissions, calculations, integration configuration and data remain unchanged.
remaining_validation: Full regression suite and browser screenshots/computed-style comparisons are consolidated by the parent agent. This source/test report alone does not assert complete visual validation.
